changes:
Re-arm Touch ID with the password after a lockout (aurora-sep-userspace touchid-rearm at the aurora-touchid-rearm pin): the pam_aurora_touchid module, the socket-activated aurora-touchid-rearm helper and aurora-touchid-boot.service (the password once after boot, /etc/aurora/touchid.conf).
The PAM module goes into common-auth's additional block through a pam-auth-update profile, so it runs only after an accepted login; aurora-touchid-rearm.socket and aurora-touchid-boot.service are enabled, as alarm-aurora's preset does.
notes: alarm-aurora's aurora-sep adds '-auth optional pam_aurora_touchid.so' after the last auth line of /etc/pam.d/system-auth. Debian assembles common-auth with pam-auth-update, so this package ships /usr/share/pam-configs/aurora-touchid-rearm (Auth-Type: Additional) instead; the additional block runs only when the primary block (pam_unix, or pam_fprintd, after which the module does nothing because no password was given) succeeded. The helper's own PAM service is /etc/pam.d/aurora-touchid-rearm: Debian's libpam maintainer does not support /usr/lib/pam.d.
